text:
Maya: AM async — quick round (what I did / blockers / today)
Maya: did a small canary spin of the new model-rollout in eu-central-1. p95 for 4k tokens ~320ms, looks within expected band. no obvious memory pressure.
Rafael: saw increased prewarm failures in apac spot lane overnight. logs show `NodeAffinity` flapping around 02:10 UTC.
Jess: opened PR to tighten affinity and add backoff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 — @Rafael can you PTAL when you have a sec?
Liam: blocker: quota request for additional L40s in us-west-2 still pending with cloud team. ticket #12345, currently blocking larger batcher scale tests.
Anika: FYI autoscaler rolled down 12 -> 8 to drain for host maintenance in ams1; we left 2 warm lanes but one prewarm instance evicted.
ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scaled down 12 -> 8 in ams1 at 11:05 UTC. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/autoscale (event id e8f3).
Rafael: applied workaround — pinned scheduler deployment to avoid flapping during NodeAffinity handshake. monitoring error rate now.
Maya: actions: @Liam please follow up with cloud contact for quota escalation and update this thread; @Anika keep one hot prewarm lane in apac until we confirm stability.
Jess: quick command I ran to verify batchers:
```
kubectl get pods -n gpu -l app=batcher -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
```
returns 3 live batchers, queue latency steady at ~45ms for 256-token loads.
Liam: escalating quota today — sending email + Slack DM to cloud contact in ~30m :mailbox_with_mail:
Anika: canary interval extended to 12h to surface warmup regressions across timezones, ok with everyone? :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup: Good. Will hold the larger rollout until quota confirmed. No other blockers from my side.
Rafael: lgtm
Jess: merging PR after CI green, expect ~10m deploy window and brief traffic ripples — I'll post when done.
Maya: thanks all — end of async.
